findings.rule: REVIEW.md Framework rules: "In a fix-type change ... the diff must not modify test files that existed before the fix; the failing test written first is the proof."
findings.summary: This is a fix-type change (status.yaml: change_type: fix) and the diff appends test_percent_zero_whole_error_names_whole to tests/test_calc.py, a test file that existed before the fix, instead of putting the reproducing test in a new file, breaching the framework rule that the pre-existing test file stay untouched so the failing test written first is the proof.

The Layout line "percent(part, whole) is part * 100 / whole through divide, so it raises the same on a zero whole" is ambiguous now that percent's message text differs from divide's, even though the exception type is still the same; not clearly false, just worth a clarifying rewrite.
